title: Registration requests
description: Parents ask for a place through the public form. Accept a child to add them as a player, or reject the request.

pending.title: No requests waiting
pending.description: When a parent sends the registration form, the request appears here. Copy the link and share it with parents.

accepted.title: Nothing accepted yet
accepted.description: Children you accept become players and are listed here.

rejected.title: Nothing rejected
rejected.description: Requests you reject are kept here.

loadError.title: Couldn't load the requests
loadError.description: Check your connection and try again.

link.copied: Link copied — paste it into a message
link.copyFailed: Couldn't copy the link. Copy it by hand:

warning.title: Check before accepting
warning.existingPlayer: A player with this CPR already exists:
warning.samePending: Another request that is still waiting has the same CPR.

loadError.title: Couldn't load this request
loadError.description: Check your connection and try again.

whatsapp.title: Tell the parent
whatsapp.hint: The app sends nothing by itself. This opens WhatsApp with the message below ready, in the language the parent used — you can edit it before sending.
whatsapp.badNumber: This phone number can't be used for WhatsApp. Call the parent instead.
whatsapp.accepted: Hello {{guardian}}, this is Ajyal Academy. Good news: the registration of {{player}} has been accepted. Welcome to the academy! We will contact you with the training details.
whatsapp.rejected: Hello {{guardian}}, this is Ajyal Academy. Thank you for registering {{player}}. Unfortunately we have no place available at the moment. You are welcome to contact us or apply again later.

accept.title: Accept {{name}}
accept.description: This adds the child as a player. Choose a coach now, or assign one later like for any player.

location.hint: The parent asked for this location. Change it if the child will train somewhere else.

accept.cprTaken: A player with this CPR already exists, so this request can't be accepted.

reject.title: Reject {{name}}
reject.description: The request is kept. The parent is not told automatically — after rejecting you can message them on WhatsApp.

note.label: Note for the team
note.hint: Optional. Only admins can see it.

error.already_decided: This request was already decided. Reload the page to see the result.
